name: product
title: Product
description: Compound Product primitives (Root, Title, Subtitle, Description, Price, Options, OptionButton, QuantitySelect, Rating, JsonLd) over a Medusa StoreProduct. Rating renders the product's aggregate star summary from the sveltekit-medusa-sdk reviews remote (re-exporting Star from the `review` atom) and JsonLd emits schema.org Product/AggregateOffer markup. URL-driven variant selection (?v= links), inventory-aware option availability (manage_inventory/inventory_quantity), currency-aware price with sale strikethrough, sanitized {@html} description. Pure resolution logic in product-logic.ts; no $effect (SSR-safe). Fetch the product reactively in your route and pass it in.

<script lang="ts">
	import { page } from '$app/state'
	import { getProductContext } from './ctx.svelte.js'
	import JsonLd from '$lib/components/ui/seo/json-ld.svelte'
	import { productSchema } from './product-schema.js'
	import type { Product, WithContext } from 'schema-dts'

	let {
		override,
		transform
	}: {
		override?: Partial<Product>
		transform?: (schema: WithContext<Product>) => WithContext<Product>
	} = $props()
	const ctx = getProductContext()

	const schema = $derived.by(() => {
		const auto = productSchema(ctx.product, { url: page.url.href })
		if (!auto) return null
		const merged = (override ? { ...auto, ...override } : auto) as WithContext<Product>
		return transform ? transform(merged) : merged
	})
</script>

{#if schema}<JsonLd {schema} />{/if}

{#if summary && summary.count > 0}
{#each fills as fill, i (i)}{/each} ({summary.count})
{/if}
